Proof in the paper: The diffraction pattern at 2θ = 39.8° assigned to Pt(1 1 1) was detected for Pt/MTS-1-MS, indicating that Pt NPs were successfully loaded on MTS-1-MS. Surprisingly, the diffraction peak at around 2θ of 39.8° obviously shifted to higher angle after Fe doping (Fig. 2b), a hint that part of Fe inserted to Pt(1 1 1) facets and caused lattice compression to a certain extent. Hence, Pt-Fe alloy with fcc structure formed.
